subject: Priv deploy fee phasing, invoice deferral & seatless operator licensing clarifications
messages:
From: Sandra Li <sli@novamed.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify VPC fees & PO timing

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profile and the control plane options. Before we get legal involved, procurement asked for a clear breakdown on two items that are blocking our PO cadence:

1) Platform fee amortization — can Redwood spread the platform fee over the first 12 months on the invoice side (we prefer CAPEX vs OPEX timing).
2) Seatless operator licensing — you mentioned an operator bundle for SREs that is not seat-based. Can you confirm exactly what triggers that license (per-site vs per-GPU vs per-operator)?

Also — our finance team needs a 60-day invoice window for initial pilots due to month-end close cycles. Is that something Redwood can accommodate?

Appreciate a short written note we can include in the procurement packet.

Best,
Sandra
Sandra Li
Head of Infrastructure Programs
Novamed
(Attachment: Novamed_RFI_requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 24 KB))

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Li <sli@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify VPC fees & PO timing

Sandra — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, and I can follow with a short formal note for procurement:

• Platform fee amortization: We can issue the platform fee as a single SOW line item and amortize it on our side across 12 months for internal reporting. For invoicing, we can offer two options: (A) bill full platform fee up front at contract signature, or (B) split the platform fee over the first 12 monthly invoices. Option B typically requires a short credit/escrow arrangement on our billing side — we can accommodate for pilots.

• Seatless operator licensing: We support a "site-based operator" model for PrivDeploy. Licensing triggers per-deployment site (logical VPC or on-prem cluster) rather than per individual SRE. If you expect multiple isolated clusters in region, each cluster counts as one operator bundle. GPU count does not directly increase operator licenses; node count only matters for deployment sizing/throughput pricing.

• 60-day invoice window: We can offer a one-time 60-day deferral on the pilot invoice up to $100k net, subject to a signed payment schedule. For long-term contracts we typically move to net-30/45.

I'll attach a short SOW template and a pricing sketch so procurement has something to review. If you can confirm expected pilot scale (approx GPUs or qps), we can put numbers in the table.

Regards,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: PrivDeploy_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 152 KB); Attachment: PrivDeploy_Pricing_Table.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB))

From: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sandra Li <sli@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify VPC fees & PO timing

Aditya — appreciate the quick response. A few clarifications from procurement and finance:

• Pilot scale: targeting 4 nodes (each 8xA10 or equivalent) across one US region.
• We prefer the platform fee split across 12 invoices (Option B) and need that explicitly called out in the billing terms.
• The 60-day deferral requested is only for pilot invoices; if pilot expands to production, we will move to standard net-45.

Can you produce a short procurement note with the exact billing language we can insert into the PO? Also — any chance of a modest pilot discount on the platform fee given we are committing to a production evaluation within 90 days?

Thanks,
Novamed Procurement
procurement@novamed.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Novamed procurement language request — draft proposal inside

Folks — looping you in to align on a written procurement clause and the discount ask. Draft below that I'd like to send to Novamed if you're OK:

--- Draft procurement clause (for PO) ---
"Redwood Inference will invoice the Platform Fee in equal monthly installments across the first twelve (12) months of the Agreement. For the initial Pilot period only, Redwood agrees to a one-time invoice deferral of up to sixty (60) days for Pilot invoices not exceeding One Hundred Thousand U.S. Dollars (USD $100,000). All invoices following the Pilot shall follow Net-45 terms unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Operator licensing for Private Deployment is applied on a per-deployment-site basis (one operator bundle per logical VPC or on-prem cluster). Operator bundles are not billed per individual SRE user.
"
--- end draft ---

Recommended commercial concession to close pilot: 30% off the platform fee for the first three months of the pilot (applied to the amortized monthly platform fee). We'd also offer a $10k one-time implementation credit if Novamed signs an MSA within 90 days. That nets to roughly a ~25% effective concession across the first three months.

Karthik — do we have margin headroom for 30% pilot discount + $10k credit at the 4-node scale? Marissa — if yes, please help me prepare a short proposal doc (I attached the pricing table).

Thanks — I want to keep the external note short and procurement-ready.

-Aditya
(Internal note: forwarding attachments: PrivDeploy_Pricing_Table.xlsx; Redwood_Proposal_v2.docx)
